Proof in the paper: The XPS and HAADF STEM results indicated that the predominant polymorph in all catalysts, both unpromoted and oxide-promoted, after activation via reduction in hydrogen flow was face-centered cubic (fcc) Co0 (Figure S24). The HAADF STEM images provided insights into the surface topology, including both extended terraces and step-edge topological motifs present on the surface of fcc cobalt nanoparticles.
